title: Frontend Design Pro JSON Envelope
description: Schema for structured output emitted when the [json] shortcode is used. schema_version tracks the ENVELOPE CONTRACT ('12.0'), not the package version — the package version lives in metadata.json. Validated on every build by scripts/test_v12_pipeline.py against both the example below and the envelope documented in AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT.md Section 7.

schema_version.description: Envelope contract version. Independent of the package version.

component.description: Complete, runnable component source code as a string.

intent.description: Primary intent classified in the DETECT stage.

mode.description: Execution mode selected in the CLASSIFY stage.

files_loaded.description: Every file actually read, relative to the skill root — e.g. SKILL.md, skills/forms/SKILL.md, core/component-api.md.

skills_loaded.description: The skills/{id}/SKILL.md routed to. Normally exactly one — the registry loads a single skill per request.

shortcodes_detected.description: Shortcodes parsed from the user prompt. Routing is keyword-based; [json] is the only shortcode the registry still honours.

design_md_tokens_overridden.description: Whether a user-supplied DESIGN.md token file overrode defaults in CLASSIFY.

eval_ids_applicable.description: IDs of evals/evals.json entries applicable to this component type.

constraints_passed.description: Constraint IDs that passed VALIDATE. The pattern admits digit-bearing prefixes (A11Y-01, 3D-01) and suffixed variants (COL-02-AST, PERF-04R) — the previous ^[A-Z]+-[0-9]+$ could express neither, and rejected the schema's own example.

constraints_checked.description: Total constraints checked in VALIDATE. Ceiling is the 56 machine-enforced constraints in core/validate-checklist.md (17 parser + 39 regex); was capped at 29 against a retired v12 registry.
